import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false

theorem closed_subspace_trace_basis_compact_refinement {K : Type*} [MetricSpace K] [CompactSpace K] {A : Set K} (hA : IsClosed A) :
  ∃ (B : Set (Set K)), Set.Countable B ∧
    (∀ U ∈ B, IsOpen U) ∧
    TopologicalSpace.IsTopologicalBasis
      (Set.image (fun U : Set K => (Subtype.val : A → K) ⁻¹' U) B) ∧
    IsCompact A ∧
    (∀ x : K, x ∈ A → ∀ U : Set K, IsOpen U → x ∈ U →
      ∃ V ∈ B, x ∈ V ∧ IsCompact (closure V) ∧ closure V ⊆ U) := by
  classical
  let B : Set (Set K) := TopologicalSpace.countableBasis K
  
  have hCount : B.Countable := by
    simpa [B] using TopologicalSpace.countable_countableBasis K
  
  have hOpen : ∀ U ∈ B, IsOpen U := by
    intro U hU
    exact TopologicalSpace.isOpen_of_mem_countableBasis
      (by simpa [B] using hU)
  
  have hBasis :
      TopologicalSpace.IsTopologicalBasis
        (Set.image (fun U : Set K => (Subtype.val : A → K) ⁻¹' U) B) := by
    simpa [B] using
      (TopologicalSpace.IsTopologicalBasis.induced (Subtype.val : A → K)
        (TopologicalSpace.isBasis_countableBasis K))
  
  have hRefine :
      ∀ x : K, x ∈ A → ∀ U : Set K, IsOpen U → x ∈ U →
        ∃ V ∈ B, x ∈ V ∧ IsCompact (closure V) ∧ closure V ⊆ U := by
    intro x hxA U hU hxU
  
    have hcompact_x : IsCompact ({x} : Set K) :=
      isCompact_singleton
  
    have hsingletonU : ({x} : Set K) ⊆ U := by
      rintro y rfl
      exact hxU
  
    obtain ⟨W, hWopen, hsingletonW, hclWsub, hclWcompact⟩ :=
      exists_open_between_and_isCompact_closure hcompact_x hU hsingletonU
  
    have hxW : x ∈ W := by
      apply hsingletonW
      simp
  
    have hWnhds : W ∈ 𝓝 x :=
      hWopen.mem_nhds hxW
  
    have hAmbientBasis :=
      TopologicalSpace.isBasis_countableBasis K
  
    obtain ⟨V, hVB, hxV, hVW⟩ :=
      hAmbientBasis.mem_nhds_iff.mp hWnhds
  
    have hSelected : V ∈ B ∧ x ∈ V ∧ V ⊆ W := by
      exact ⟨by simpa [B] using hVB, hxV, hVW⟩
  
    have hclsub : closure V ⊆ closure W :=
      closure_mono hSelected.2.2
  
    have hclU : closure V ⊆ U :=
      hclsub.trans hclWsub
  
    have hclcompact : IsCompact (closure V) :=
      hclWcompact.of_isClosed_subset isClosed_closure hclsub
  
    exact ⟨V, hSelected.1, hSelected.2.1, hclcompact, hclU⟩
  
  exact ⟨B, hCount, hOpen, hBasis, hA.isCompact, hRefine⟩

      ∃ V ∈ B, x ∈ V ∧ IsCompact (closure V) ∧ closure V ⊆ U) := by
  let B : Set (Set K) := TopologicalSpace.countableBasis K
  refine ⟨B, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact TopologicalSpace.countable_countableBasis K
  · intro U hU
    exact TopologicalSpace.isOpen_of_mem_countableBasis hU
  · exact isTopologicalBasis_subtype
      (TopologicalSpace.isBasis_countableBasis K) A

    refine ⟨V, hVB, hxV, ?_, hVU⟩
